could_not_settle: The card says the three loans together financed 'the Khurja-to-Mughal Sarai freight line'. The completion report gives EDFC-1 as the 343 km Khurja-Kanpur section, EDFC-2 as the 393 km Kanpur-Mughal Sarai section and EDFC-3 as the 401 km Ludhiana-Khurja section. This is an error on the card, but none of the brief's ten classes covers a mis-stated project scope, so it is left here rather than written as a correction with a class that does not fit.

bujagali.checked: Inspection Panel Investigation Report (Uganda, Private Power Generation (Bujagali), P089659) paras 99-103 and footnote 72; CAO Compliance Investigation Report Bujagali-04 and -06, project description, timeline and the MIGA supervision section; AfDB Independent Review Mechanism Compliance Review Report, 20 June 2008, pp.18-19; EIB Complaints Mechanism Conclusions Report SG/E/2009/09, 30 August 2012, fact sheet ('Board Report 09.05.2007', 'Contract amount: EUR equivalent of up to 130 M USD'). World Bank project number for the guarantee operation: P089659 (API projects query, board approval 26 April 2007).
could_not_settle: The MIGA entry dates the original US$115 million guarantee to June 2007. The CAO report gives the amount, the beneficiary (World Power Holdings Luxembourg), the 2012 increase of US$5.3 million and the 2014 guarantees of US$9.5 million to Absa and Standard Chartered, but its timeline columns do not survive text extraction, so no document I opened puts a month on the issuance. Nothing contradicts June 2007 either.

The documents give three different cost figures and the card uses two of them: the Inspection Panel puts total project cost at about US$798.6 million, the CAO report at about US$750 million and the financing package at about US$900 million. The card's 'roughly $900 million' is the CAO's package figure and the AfDB's 'US$735.5 million cost' is the AfDB appraisal figure. Both are quoted from the right document; the three figures are left unreconciled.

dakar-diamniadio-toll-highway.checked: World Bank Project Appraisal Document 43441 (cover 6 May 2009) financing data table, component descriptions B, C and D, para 42 and Annex 5 cost table; IFC Summary of Proposed Investment for project 29008 (Approved Sep 30, 2010, Signed Nov 14, 2010); IFC press release of 15 November 2010. Project number resolved: P087304 (API projects query, board approval 2 June 2009).
could_not_settle: The AfDB entry (UA 45 million approved 15 July 2009; EUR 12 million plus a EUR 1.5 million standby approved 19 July 2010) and the sentence attributed to 'the AfDB review' both rest on the AfDB Compliance Review and Mediation Unit problem-solving report. Two routes failed: curl on the afdb.org PDF returns a Cloudflare 'Just a moment' challenge page of 5.9 KB instead of the file, and the WebFetch permission request for the same URL went unanswered. The accountability console page for the case carries none of the figures.

The appraisal document's own para 42 cuts against the card's reading of the components: 'For components B and C the co-financiers will be the AFD, the World Bank and the GoS. As for component D, project management, expenditures (operations costs) will be fully covered by the World Bank.' So component D was the Bank's alone, not the Bank's and AFD's. The card attributes the B-C-D sentence to the AfDB review, which could not be opened, so it is recorded here rather than corrected.

The first sentence says the IDA credit was 'for the whole project'. The appraisal document says IDA did not finance Component A, the road itself: 'Even though IDA is not financing this component, the Bank has facilitated the process ...', with IDA's money in Component B (US$58.5 million), Component C (US$27.3 million) and Component D. Worth a rewrite in a later round; no class in this brief covers it.
